title: Link persistence temp write follows attacker-controlled symlink
description: python LinkLayer persistence uses predictable <path>.tmp with O_CREAT|O_TRUNC and no O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW or verified directory ownership/mode. An attacker able to write the persistence directory can preplant a symlink and make a privileged LinkLayer truncate/overwrite an arbitrary target before os.replace. Use dir-fd based unique exclusive no-follow temporary files, validate regular-file ownership/mode and directory policy, fsync and replace within the verified directory, and fail closed. Add symlink/preexisting-temp/race/permissive-directory tests proving targets remain untouched.
